item: RSZ-0060-CLASS (RSZ-0060 'Max buffer count reached' is NOT a failure cause)
note: KV-NOROW RC-KV#47. Root cause: OpenROAD prints [ERROR RSZ-0060] when repair_timing hits -max_buffer_percent. The kit's hold guard (tools/orfs_hold_mm.tcl hold_guard_grt.tcl) deliberately calls repair_timing -hold in chunks of 200 buffers (-max_buffer_percent 0.064111 = 200/311,959 insts) and catches the error ('OT_HOLD_GUARD_GRT: chunk buffer caps reached (RSZ-0060 caught per chunk); continuing on the repaired design'); OT_HOLD_STOP does the same by design. Census of 49 RSZ-0060 lines in KV kit run_*.log on intel1/intel2/epyc2/7/8: 49/49 caught, 0 uncaught. tt_setup_repair_grt.log of hgi_v8 and pc (the 'GRT repair collapses setup' kits) contain no RSZ-0060: their setup loss is route detour (hgi_v8 CTS -97 -> GRT -733) and legs (pc -1,292 ps est), covered by their route/leg rows, not by the resizer. No tool or plan fix needed; classify caught RSZ-0060 as INFO in kit reads (fail_cause.py already excludes it via HOLD_GUARD_CAP_RE). Real cost to watch: one 200-buffer chunk took 2,815 s on hgi_v2 (312k insts) = ~13 min per 56 buffers, so a 30k-hold-cell storm needs structural hold fixes (KV-HOLD-STRUCT), not a larger cap.
